package private

import (
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

func TestLessonRevisionRoutesRequireInternalToken(t *testing.T) {
	router := NewRouter(nil, &handlers.LessonHandler{}, nil, nil, "secret", "", "")
	for _, route := range []struct{ method, path string }{{http.MethodPost, "/lessons/lesson/revision"}, {http.MethodGet, "/lesson-revisions/revision"}} {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(route.method, route.path, nil)
		w := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(w, req)
		if w.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
			t.Fatalf("%s %s got %d", route.method, route.path, w.Code)
		}
	}
}
